name: How to Choose the Right Bathroom Lighting

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Picking out the perfect lighting for your bathroom can feel a bit overwhelming, right? There are a few key things to keep in mind to make sure you get it right. First, think about the different activities you do in your bathroom. You'll want good task lighting around your mirror for grooming, and ambient lighting for overall brightness. Accent lighting can add a nice touch for ambiance. Brightness is super important in bathrooms, and many experts recommend a brighter, cooler light. This helps you see clearly and reduces shadows, especially around the mirror. You'll also want to consider the size of your fixtures relative to the room, and make sure they're not too big or too small. Don't forget about the beam direction and color temperature – these really impact the feel of the space. And here's a big one: if your bathroom lighting project involves new wiring, multiple circuits, dimmers, or fixtures near moisture, it’s definitely a good idea to bring in a pro. They can ensure everything is up to code and safe, especially with those damp- or wet-rated fixtures near showers or tubs. Frasheski Construction can help guide you through these choices to create a well-lit bathroom that meets your needs.
